title: Cost of selfishness in the allocation of cities in the Multiple Travelling Salesmen Problem
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measures the efficiency (total route length and computation time) of different organizational models for solving the Multiple Travelling Salesmen Problem.
findings: The paper has no findings related to religion as it is not a subject of the study.
